jobs_results.title: Java Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos buenos profesionales que quieran estabilidad en su carrera profesional y personal, centrarse en un proyecto de empresa y trabajar con un equipo técnico y humano agradable.

IMPORTANTE: El trabajo puede ser desarrollado de manera remota, híbrida o presencial a elección del trabajador y siempre acorde a su capacidad de autonomía.

OFRECEMOS:
• Trabajo indefinido, horario flexible con posibilidad de trabajo híbrido o remoto total.
• Carrera profesional y salario bruto base (requisitos indispensables) 45.000€ - 27.000€ según experiencia en sector y cercanía a producto:
• 45.000€ Analistas/Programadores senior en JAVA Backend y participación en productos o proyectos de gestión tipo POS/ERP/SGA/CRM, idealmente relacionadas con el RETAIL
• 41.000€ Analistas/programadores senior en JAVA BAckend/FullStack
• 35.000€ Programadores JAVA con al menos 2 años de experiencia real Senior
• 27.000€ Programadores con grado universitario informático sin experiencia
• 21.000€ Programadores con... grado FP en aplicaciones multiplataforma y al menos 2 años de experiencia Junior
• etc.
• Bono adicional por contrato de 1.500€ ante cumplimiento de objetivos
• Posibilidad de reducción voluntaria a 35h semanales y salida todos los días a las 15h.
• Plus para perfiles que cumplan los requisitos de revalorización.
• 12 o 14 pagas a elegir
• Salida todos los viernes a las 15:00h para jornadas de 40h.
• 2 meses jornada intensiva
• Posibilidad de desarrollo profesional a Analista, Jefe de Proyectos o Director de departamento.
• Empresa nicho de producto, pequeña y muy humana.
• Trabajo en empresa cómoda, joven y en pleno centro de Madrid.

En este momento, queremos programadores senior con:

REQUISITOS INDISPENSABLES:
• Experiencia FullStack con peso y experiencia real en Java Backend v 1.8 o similar
• Buen nivel de:

-Programación JAVA puro con id Eclipse o similar

-JavaScript, HTML5, CSS

-SQL (programación)
• Habituado a trabajo en equipo, GIT, Jira o similar

REQUISITOS QUE REVALORIZARÁN LA OFERTA:

El cumplimiento de alguno de los siguientes requisitos puede suponer una re-evaluación de la oferta económica.

Experiencia en:
• Empresa consolidada de ERP, POS en alguna empresa similar a AQS
• Jefe de proyectos en multiples proyectos simultáneos en clientes reales
• Jefe de departamento de desarrollo, tecnología Agile-Scrum, producto & proyectos

SOBRE AQS

Somos fabricantes de productos propios de software (www.aqs.es), no somos consultora de servicios ni hacemos proyectos puntuales.

Al ser fabricantes de producto necesitamos cuidar el código, ser minuciosos, controlar las versiones con especial cuidado.

Nos encontramos en la calle Gran Vía, en Madrid. Comunicada con todo tipo de transporte.

Somos una empresa con más de 20 años, es decir no somos una startup, sino una empresa con producto y clientes consolidados.

Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo personal en modalidad contrato fijo

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Developer Remote Work
jobs_results.description:
At Baires Dev, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.

Senior Java Developer (Spain) at Baires Dev

As a Senior Java Developer at Baires Dev, your experience and skills will be crucial in solving complex problems and contributing to innovative projects.

What You Will Do:

- Design, implement, and support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.
- Technically own different platform modules, including design, development, and... integration.
- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered to.
- Conduct code reviews for junior team members and do peer code reviews to ensure the code follows standards set forward by the architects.
- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.
- Resolve code issues with urgency.

Here’s what we are looking for:

- 5+ years of experience in Java.
- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.
- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.
- Experience in automated tests, and CI/CD pipelines.
- Strong experience with version control.
- Fluent Spanish level.
- Intermediate English Level.

How we make your work (and your life) easier:
• 100% remote work (from anywhere).
• Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
• Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
• Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
• Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.
• Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
• Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Programador Java (Jornada intensiva todo el año) - Madrid, España
jobs_results.description:
En Sandav estamos buscando un programador Java para formar parte de un proyecto de modernización, que supondrá la introducción gradual de una nueva arquitectura de aplicaciones, desarrollo, infraestructura y seguridad. Algunas de las tecnologías utilizadas serán Java 21, Angular 17, arquitectura por eventos y despliegue DevSecFinOps.

Requisitos
• Java (versión 17/ 20)
• SpringBoot
• SQL y LiquiBase
• Entorno Eclipse
• GitLab o equivalente
• Jest y Cypress

Valorable
• Conocimientos en PostgreSQL y MongoDB
• Conocimientos en Gherkin, Swagger y Lombok
• Conocimientos en JIRA, Jenkins y SonarQube

Condiciones De La Oferta
• Contrato indefinido con el cliente.
• Salario acorde a la experiencia y conocimientos aportados.
• Puesto estable.
• Modelo de trabajo híbrido: 2 días de teletrabajo, 3 presenciales.
• Ubicación: Aravaca (Madrid).
• Horario: de 7:45 a 15:15 todo el año (jornada de siete horas y media al día).

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Developer
jobs_results.description:
Do you want to work for an International Service Delivery Center in Valencia as a Senior Java Developer?

At ERNI’s Service Delivery Center, you will have the opportunity to work on a flexible hybrid mode from our offices in Valencia and grow your professional experience in all lifecycle phases of Software development (new developments, maintenance, devops, …) from the sensor to the app.

ERNI is building a global platform based on a Swiss mindset and adapted to the needs of local customers and works typically for headquarters of national & international market champions in defined Countries (CH, DE, US, SG, …) and in selected domains (MedTech, Industry, Finance, Transportation).

All, with self-managed teams, which allows us to be more agile in decision making, more responsible and delivery focused. We offer you to grow hand in hand, in technical and soft skills and we even reward you for it!

Why join ERNI?

👌PERKS AND BENEFITS
• Permanent contract: there is always a project for... you to keep working with us
• Free languages courses: learn German and Spanish or improve your English skills
• Private medical insurance: private medical insurance for you and a 100% salary coverage on sickness leave
• Flexible compensation: dedicate part of your gross salary to different options: transportation bonus, ticket restaurant, kindergarten bonus and add a family member into your own insurance plan.
• Gym Funding: ERNI bets on a healthy lifestyle, for that reason, we offer you special discounts on fitness facilities.
• Referral program: extra bonus with our “Candidate’s referral program” from 2.000€ to 6.000€ depending on the candidate seniority level; and an extra bonus, also with our “Business opportunity referral program” from 500€ to 5.000€ depending on the opportunity size and customer.
• Life support: to strengthen our commitment to conciliation and willingness of being close in your day-to-day life and important moments. We provide you a set of services and benefits, free of charge for, to assist you and your family in legal consultation, personal assistance, etc.
• Tea, coffee and fruits in the office.

🌱DEVELOPMENT & GROWTH
• Paid and rewarded certifications: learn new technologies to develop as a professional in areas such as: Agile, DevOps, Cloud, QA, etc. and be rewarded from 200€ to 1.400€ per certification, in addition to the paid exam.
• High Value Training: after a year at ERNI, you will have the opportunity to enroll on +500€ Executive courses, Masters or Postgraduates. 80% of the total amount will be covered by the company.
• Challenging projects: ERNI is dedicated to develop high-quality software in complex technical environments such as MedTech, Industry, Finance and Transportation. Have the chance to participate in a variety of technical challenging projects amongst passionate and skilled colleagues.
• Proximity and support: from the first day at ERNI, you will be guided by a Mentor and a People Development team that will make sure you have the right tools to develop and give you opportunities to grow in a project or to switch to a new one.
• Promotions & Recognition: from the very first day, we offer you a way to learn and develop yourself in our company. All efforts are always recognized and appreciated by your colleagues and superiors which makes feel satisfied with your own achievements.
• Communication: you will find transparency, honesty, and open communication all over the organization through a breakfast with our MD and a monthly session to be updated on what’s going on at ERNI.

🕛FLEXIBILITY
• Hybrid working model: at ERNI we believe in the importance of building strong relationships with our colleagues, projects and customers. We believe that building these relationships is much more effective when done in person.
• Home Office: you will receive an extra monthly compensation to cover your teleworking expenses, as well as any necessary equipment to be comfortable doing your job.
• Far Home Office: you can extend your holidays and work remotely from any European country or Spanish city up to 5 weeks per year.
• Flexible working shift*: you will enjoy a Friday intensive shift and a self-managed flexible working hours.

💃TEAM & COMMUNITY EVENTS
• Events: we do believe in the importance of meeting our colleagues in an informal and natural environment to build connections and foster trust so that we feel like home. Leisure events, Christmas dinner and summer party are waiting for you!
• Jubilee at –5

What You’ll Bring:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or Technical Science
• At least 4 years of professional experience with JEE or other Java frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Spring MVC...)
• Professional experience with data modelling and ORM tools (e.g., Hibernate)
• Professional experience using Java development tools (e.g., Eclipse, JUnit, Git)
• Professional experience with relational or other database platforms, SQL or other query languages
• Business fluent English (spoken and written), German is a plus

What You’ll Do:
• Developing complex software Java applications in all its lifecycle phases (analysis, development, testing, maintenance etc.)
• Working with agile methodology (Scrum, SAFe etc)
• Being part of a self-managed autonomous team
• Participate in international projects of market champions

Find out more about our ERNI Software Delivery Center

At ERNI we believe in the impact of Swiss Software Engineering to create customers value.

Therefore, we are building a global platform based on a Swiss mindset and adapted to the needs of local customers. Our clients profit from method-based consulting services, partnership-oriented technology and cost-conscious delivery services. Since the foundation in Switzerland in 1994, sharing know-how to establish collective skills and focusing on economically sound engineering solutions, played a key role and are the basis for successful software projects.

Today, the ERNI Group has more than 800 employees at 18 locations in 8 countries and continues to grow.

In Spain, ERNI has already almost 300 ERNIans working for Spanish customers, with sites in Madrid and Barcelona. Now we are expanding our Business in Spain with our international Delivery Center, growing the team doing projects for our customers in Switzerland, Germany, US and Asia Pacific.

jobs_results.title: Java Developer Senior - Proyecto 6 Meses (100% Teletrabajo)
jobs_results.description:
Desde Sandav Consultores estamos en búsqueda de un Programador Java Senior para un cliente con modalidad 100% teletrabajo. Se trata de un proyecto inicialmente de 6 meses con posibilidad de que se amplíe y se convierta en estable.

Se valoran candidaturas a partir de dos (2) años de experiencia.

Funciones a Realizar

Participar de forma activa en la planificación incremental del trabajo (marcos de trabajo agile).

Participar de forma proactiva en el diseño y la implementación del código de la aplicación de punto de venta.

Realizar el trabajo de desarrollo según las prioridades establecidas por el propio equipo de desarrollo, incluida la documentación técnica.

Cumplir y hacer cumplir los requisitos generales de calidad exigidos para el software de punto de venta.

Cumplir y mantener las métricas de calidad del código fuente de la aplicación

Probar de forma unitaria e integrada el funcionamiento de cada uno de los desarrollos realizados.

Cumplir los compromisos de desarrollo en el... plazo de tiempo convenido y advertir de posibles desviaciones.

Realizar el trabajo correctivo de la aplicación en función a la planificación incremental y las prioridades que sean establecidas en cada momento.

Construir y mantener modelos de datos acordes a los requerimientos de la organización.

Programar consultas para obtener información de bases de datos de acuerdo a los requerimientos de la organización.

Documentar y respaldar las aplicaciones y/o procesos de acuerdo con las normas establecidas.

Se Requiere

Se requiere alguna de las siguientes formaciones: FP en Programación, Ingeniería técnica o superior en informática, grado en informática.

Se requiere inglés técnico con un nivel medio de lectura y escritura.

Programación orientada a objetos en JAVA 8.

Test unitarios con JUnit.

Spring Framework.

Java Database Connection JDBC API.

Bases de datos relacionales DDL y DML.

Scripting en Linux (Bash).

Uso de sistemas operativos Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora).

Se Ofrece

Proyecto inicialmente de 6 meses con posibilidad de que se amplíe y se convierta en estable.

Contrato indefinido.

Modalidad de trabajo: 100% teletrabajo.

Salario: 35.000EUR - 45.000EUR /brutos (en función de la experiencia aportada por parte del candidato). Se valoran candidaturas con salarios superiores.

Seguro médico opcional que incluye seguro dental y psicología y retribución flexible a nivel de tickets restaurante.

Cursos de formación gratuita

jobs_results.title: Ingénieur logiciel Java/Ingénieure logiciel Java
jobs_results.description:
Joining WIDE means joining an innovative agency that empowers brands and businesses. With a diverse team of talents, we tackle communication challenges head-on, from ecosystem deployment to e-commerce and beyond. Our international clients in luxury, outdoor, and financial sectors appreciate our unbridled creativity.

As the largest agency in French-speaking Switzerland, WIDE offers a unique opportunity for growth and collaboration. Currently, we're seeking a Senior Java Back-end Developer to join our team.

Tasks:

· Back-end development with Java

· Deployment of Java services enabling the management of services (subscriptions, daily tickets, etc.) for the provision of automated control devices (cameras, barriers, etc.).

· Experience with Kafka

Profile:

· + 5 years on Back-end development with Java and Kafka

· French is mandatory (at least intermediate)

As a plus:
• English is a plus.

Benefits:

· We offer a competitive salary based on your experience.

·· Flexibility of... working 100% remotely

· We offer tailored and certified training programs to advance your career

· Your personal qualities will make the difference: rigorous professional ethics, autonomy while having a team spirit, analysis and synthesis skills, listening, creativity, sense of service, sense of customer relations and commitment.

At WIDE, we value not only your skills and experience but also your personality, interpersonal skills, and enthusiasm for contributing to our company culture. If your qualifications, growth mindset, and personality align with our vision, we're excited to welcome you on board!

Don't hesitate to join us: https://www.wideagency.ch/articles/les-5-bonnes-raisons-de-nous-rejoindre
